'''Imperial Infantry Division 130''' was a division within the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] the unit was garrisoned on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] and was send to reinforce an Imperial operative assaulting [[Exchange]] forces under [[Kiregan Freem]].<ref name="TOR" />
